premises.text: Living with diabetes requires constant blood-sugar management that is hard because many life factors affect sugar and people miss injections or miscalculate doses
premises.evidence_span: Living with diabetes is incredibly difficult because everything affects my sugar

premises.text: Existing diabetes apps only add logging and manual analysis rather than proactive help
premises.evidence_span: all they do is provide us with fancy tools so that we can do hard work of logging details and then manually analyzing them or sharing them

premises.text: Spike automatically collects life, activity, and vital details to give proactive insulin tips, reminders, and food suggestions
premises.evidence_span: By automatically collecting details about your life, your routine, your activity, and your vitals, Spike proactively provides you with the right insulin tips and reminders with food suggestions

premises.text: Integrations with patches and glucometers automatically capture glucose readings
premises.evidence_span: Supporting more than 10 other glucometers spike would automatically get a reading

premises.text: Context such as entering a restaurant triggers top food options with approximate carb counts
premises.evidence_span: she would automatically get the top three food options she would have with approximate carb count

premises.text: Guardians and doctors get real-time status and alerts on unusual patterns
premises.evidence_span: they are informed in real time about her situation. But they are also alerted if unusual pattern is detected or something is wrong

premises.text: Spike is free for diabetics while insurers and self-insured employers pay
premises.evidence_span: spike is free forever for diabetics

premises.text: Differentiation is intervening before incidents rather than after
premises.evidence_span: the problem lies before the incident happens, not after it

domains.name: Proactive Spike assistant and device data

value.text: Make diabetes management less work and less worry for diabetics

secondary_value.text: Reduce productivity loss and prevent mismanagement-related deaths
secondary_value.evidence_span: she would be part of the $90 billion loss of productivity from diabetics in the US only
